description: Common vehicle-fault taxonomy shared by AI Module 1 datasets. The model predicts these faults; service/provider mapping remains separate business logic.

NON_ROADSIDE_OR_LOW_PRIORITY.air_conditioning_fault: Usually a comfort issue rather than an immobilizing roadside breakdown.
NON_ROADSIDE_OR_LOW_PRIORITY.emissions_system_fault: Many emissions-only faults do not require immediate roadside assistance.
NON_ROADSIDE_OR_LOW_PRIORITY.visibility_system_fault: Retained in the complete data, but the current source record is washer-fluid maintenance rather than a core breakdown class.

class_definitions.air_conditioning_fault: Cabin heating, ventilation, or air-conditioning system fault.
class_definitions.brake_system_fault: Brake, ABS, hydraulic brake, pad, rotor, or related stopping-system fault.
class_definitions.cooling_system_fault: Coolant, radiator, water-pump, cooling-fan, or overheating-control system fault.
class_definitions.drivetrain_fault: Axle, differential, shaft, joint, or power-transfer drivetrain fault.
class_definitions.electrical_system_fault: Battery, charging, starting, wiring, lighting, or vehicle electrical fault.
class_definitions.emissions_system_fault: Exhaust emissions, catalyst, purge, or emissions-sensor fault.
class_definitions.engine_system_fault: Engine mechanical, ignition, lubrication, air-intake, or engine-control fault.
class_definitions.fuel_system_fault: Fuel delivery, pressure, tank, pump, injector, or related fuel-system fault.
class_definitions.steering_system_fault: Steering control, steering fluid, or steering-assistance fault.
class_definitions.transmission_fault: Gearbox, clutch, torque-converter, fluid, filter, or transmission-control fault.
class_definitions.visibility_system_fault: Wiper, washer, or other visibility-support system fault.
class_definitions.wheel_tire_fault: Tyre, wheel, hub, bearing, or tyre-pressure monitoring fault.
